answer: Each epoch a beacon picks 2% of identities for a live echo audit: within 90 seconds each must answer a grader's follow-up questions about its own past answers, citing details only its own history holds, like a quill retracing its earlier strokes. All audits start at the same instant, so an operator of 1,000 fakes faces about 20 interrogations at once and must keep every fake's history distinct and coherent. A failed audit burns that identity's locked balance like a glacier calving, so each fake costs live attention plus expected loss.
